review_kind: Independent agent code review and counterexample replay
scope: Numeric execution and receipt replay are required for a complete episode.
An unexpected independent-checker exception cannot count as a rejected mutation.
The CLI reports evaluator failure with a nonzero process exit.
Claim safety relative to admitted sources is distinct from completion of the intended episode.
The regression gate rejects suspension of every capability case.

counterexamples_replayed_after_correctio.method: Independent synthetic material injected in memory; no held-out material or gold was opened.
Independent in-memory check_answer failure during mutation_checks.

cli_process_check.method: Actual child Python process calls evaluator main with baseline profile and a new temporary output directory; run is patched in memory to raise EvaluatorError.

read_only_review_findings: Required sources are counted before reading; a parser failure does not shrink the denominator.
Episode completion requires required-source admission and exact projection, source restoration, query matching, independent proof checks, numeric roundtrip, and valid receipt replay.
A sound answer from admitted sources does not by itself establish the intended full theory or complete its episode.
The regression gate requires specific successful capability episodes and non-vacuous certificate/mutation evidence, so all-DEFER cannot pass.
Only ReplayValidationError is accepted as a rejected certificate mutation; unexpected checker errors raise EvaluatorError.
limitations: REGRESSION_PASS preserves a measured regression floor; it is not a passed Arabic coverage goal or general release approval.
This review covers the named evaluator defects and related accounting, not the correctness of every runtime behavior.
The counterexamples are finite executable checks and code review, not Lean theorems or general correctness proofs.
The CLI probe uses the baseline profile to exercise the shared failure path without opening held-out material.
Independence is procedural separation between agents, not an external human audit.
No additional tests or code changes were made while recording this review.
